programme.title: Terra Nostra
programme.desc: Terra Nostra ilustează incredibila poveste de dragoste dintre Matheu (Thiago Lacerda) și Juliana (Ana Paula Arosio), care se întâlnesc la începutul secolului al XIX-lea, în căutarea unei vieți mai bune. Ei se cunosc pe vasul care duce din Genova în Brazilia familii de italieni care vor să muncească pe plantațiile de arbori de cafea. Matheu și Juliana trăiesc o poveste fericită de iubire la bordul acestui vas, până când tragedia se abate asupra lor: părinții ei mor din… citeşte.

programme.title: Iubiri vinovate
Perdona Nuestros Pecados
programme.desc: La începutul anilor ´50, Maria, fiica unei familii puternice din înalta aristocraţie chiliană se îndrăgosteşte, nepermis, de fiul unei servitoare! Preotul Reynaldo Suarez, nou venit în localitate, se îndrăgosteşte, la rândul său, de Maria! Pe cine să aleagă el? Credinţa sau iubirea? În această lume închistată în reguli şi prejudecăţi, dragostea, e singurul sentiment care circulă liber printre oameni şi care dărâmă prejudecăţi, provocând însă drame şi suferinţe.

programme.title: Puișorii: Aventură în Africa
Little Eggs: An African Rescue
programme.desc: Toto și prietenii săi trebuie să-și salveze puișorii după ce aceștia sunt răpiți pentru un eveniment gastronomic în Africa.

programme.title: Sănătate cu stil
programme.desc: Prezentatoarea emisiunii aduce în atenţia telespectatorilor o serie întreagă de afecţiuni, cu care se confruntă tot mai mulţi români, şi oferă cele mai bune soluţii şi remedii pentru acestea, cu ajutorul celor mai buni medici din România. Telespectatorii vor afla şi cum pot avea grija cel mai bine de sănătatea lor, cum se pot hrăni sănătos, ce beneficii aduce mişcarea în viaţa lor, cum pot trata cel mai bine afecţiuni de care le este teamă sau ruşine să vorbească, dar şi cum îşi pot asigura o stare de bine cu ajutorul leacurilor din natură, al plantelor care pot face adevărate miracole pentru sănătatea lor.

programme.title: Connect
programme.desc: Emisiunea Connect își propune să prezinte săptămânal cele mai noi și interesante gadgeturi, de la cele mai cunoscute telefoane, laptopuri, wearables, aplicații și jocuri, la cele mai inedite proiecte care țin capetele de afiș ale presei de tehnologie din toată lumea.

programme.title: Insider politic
programme.desc: Un talk-show politic şi nu numai, care va aborda cele mai importante evenimente din actualitatea românească, cu două puncte de vedere asupra temei săptămânii, cel al invitatului dar şi al realizatorului.

programme.title: Zestrea domniței Ralu
programme.desc: Partea a doua a tripticului dedicat haiducului Șaptecai și episodul 5 al seriei Haiducilor. După o spectaculoasă evadare pusă la cale de Anița (Marga Barbu), Răspopitul (Toma Caragiu) și Parpanghel (Jean Constantin), căpitanul Anghel (Florin Piersic) pornește din nou spre urmele banilor. Răpind-o pe Caliopi (Carmen Maria Struja), Șaptecai cere în schimbul eliberării bijuteriile cumpărate de soțul ei, Ianis (Constantin Codrescu) la Viena. După o serie de întâmplari… citeşte.

programme.title: Life & Style cu Maria Andrei
programme.desc: Emisiunea le propune telespectatorilor să redescopere destinații bine cunoscute, dar și rute alternative, să cunoască oameni deosebiți și să le afle poveștile, rețetele gastronomice și produsele locale premiate. Maria Andrei mai aduce în atenția publicului știri pertinente și autentice cu ajutorul unor specialiști respectați, și îi ajută să fie la curent cu ultimele tendințe în domeniul life & style.

programme.title: Schimb de mame
programme.desc: Emisiunea "Schimb de mame" aduce în prim plan experienţele inedite trăite de soțiile-mame care au curajul să își schimbe viaţa pentru șapte zile. În fiecare săptămînă, două soții-mame vor face "schimb de vieți", vor avea o familie, prieteni și o slujbă complet noi, într-o localitate și o casa cu totul necunoscute. La final, protagoniștii se vor întâlni pentru a-și împărtăși experienţele trăite în răstimpul celor șapte zile și vor fi premiați.

programme.title: Cronica cârcotaşilor
programme.desc: Emisiunea Cronica cârcotaşilor prezintă o variantă unică a celor mai importante noutăţi din domeniul politic, social, cultural sau economic. Telespectatorii vor mai afla şi cum stau românii la capitolul cultură generală prin rubrica “Vocea Poporului”, iar “Top Ruşinică” face clasamentul binecunoscut al gafelor din televiziuni.

programme.title: Aventurile lui Aladin
Les nouvelles aventures d'Aladin
programme.desc: În ajun de Crăciun, Sam şi amicul lui Khalid se deghizează în Moşi Crăciun ca să poată şterpeli în voie din celebrul magazin Galeriile Lafayette din Paris. Înconjurat de copii, Sam e nevoit să le spună o poveste, o versiune inventată de el a aventurilor lui Aladin. Aşa începe o călătorie imaginară într-un Bagdad de legendă, unde tânărul hoţ Aladin, ajutat de Duhul lui, trebuie să dejoace planurile diabolice ale vizirului şi s-o cucerească pe frumoasa prinţesă Shallia.

programme.title: Operațiunea Monstrul
programme.desc: Un grup de cinci bărbați, prieteni sau colegi de serviciu, pleacă, fără știrea nevestelor, într-o expediție în Deltă. La pescuit, respectiv la vânătoare, personajele ajung în situații dintre cele mai ridicole și amuzante. Comicul de situații erupe în momentul în care, contrar uzantelor vremii, Corneluș, cel mai mic în ierarhie, prinde Monstrul.

programme.title: Cucoana Chirița
programme.desc: Întoarsă din Paris la Bârzoieni, Chirița s-a isprăvnicit! Prilej pentru ca Draga Olteanu Matei să-și dezlănțuie temperamentul vulcanic într-una din cele mai triviale adaptări dupa clasici din cinematografia noastră. Slalom între farsă și vodevil, comedie de moravuri și satiră social lingvistică, mizând mereu pe efectul ridicol exterior, fără vreo aluzie la noua rasă de ciocoi semidocți din epoca realizării filmului.

programme.desc: Versiune cinematografica dupa serialul TV "Toate panzele sus!" realizat de TVR in 1976. "Intalnire in Atlantic" este al treilea lungmetraj dintr-o serie de 3 (1. "Secretul epavei", 2. "Misterele marilor"). Ecranizare dupa romanul omonim de Radu Tudoran. Flmul prezinta aventurile a doi prieteni, romanul Lupan si francezul Vaillant, porniti pe urmele secretelor epavei corabiei L´Esperance. Aventurile celor doi prieteni continua si in ultima parte a filmului. Anton Lupan, comandantul corabiei "Speranta", exploreaza… citeşte.

programme.title: Drumul oaselor
programme.desc: Un grup al "Fratiei" pasoptiste preia o comoara a lui Tudor din Vladimiri pentru a o schimba pe arme, la Brasov, in lupta cu arnautii si cu propriile lor tentatii. Margelatu, temut de multi, ajuta rezistenta in lupta impotriva autoritatilor statului. "O echipa experimentata in filmele cu haiduci (scenaristul Eugen Barbu, actorii Florin Piersic, Marga Barbu si Ion Besoiu) si un regizor specializat in filme istorice (Doru Nastase) au reconstituit cu farmec inceputul de secol 19 romanesc si le-au adaugat aventurile lui… citeşte.

programme.title: Iubiri secrete
programme.desc: Un serial care prezinta o serie de situatii dramatice sau pline de umor si ai caror protagonisti sunt oameni obisnuiti. Plecand de la o poveste reala, Eugen, Valeria, Mircea, Radu si Andrei traiesc o viata ca in filme. Familia Maris locuieste intr-o frumoasa vila din centrul Capitalei. Eugen, capul familei, are 65 de ani si a mostenit dupa revolutie mai multe… citeşte.

programme.title: नमक हलाल

魔劍俠情 / Return of the Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: 狄龍扮演的小李悄然回到愛侶故園之旁隱居，遙對窗中倩影，而不相見，直至發生危機，小李才露面相告，並且挺身赴難。有不少高手為爭“武林排名”而找小李決鬥，小李又要對付惡勢力龐大的幫主谷峰，於是小李找尋舊友阿飛相助，但阿飛被陰險美女林仙兒所迷，簡直變成廢人，小李於是揭破這女人的假面目，並且設法使阿飛振作起來。.

programme.title: 魔界 / Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: 故事講述，警局偵緝部情侶探員鄭忠與王麗芬同往離島露營，半夜麗芬忽聞異聲，離營探看，突見綠光一閃，隨即著魔。翌日，王警官率眾處理一宗挾持人質案件，期間麗芬逕自開槍射殺劫匪，過程被雜誌記者阿古攝得，發現子彈竟能轉向殺人...

programme.title: 香港73 / Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: 1973年，香港股市暴漲人人熱衷炒賣股票，小市民因急於入住廉租屋而被不法之徒騙取金錢，及教育制度不健全引起民怨等均被改編成電影中的情節。故事諷刺寫實，反映了香港當時的真實面貌！.

programme.title: 神劍震江湖 / The Thundering Sword
programme.desc: 余乾文與同門師弟鄭坤元奉師父之命下山尋訪「天地劍」，以免它落入壞人手中造成武林浩劫。余乾文途中巧遇五毒教教主之女蘇皎皎，兩人情投意合。可惜，當蘇皎皎意外地弄傷鄭坤元後，事情也開始變得越來越複雜。.

programme.title: 喬太守亂點鴛鴦譜 / The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: 孫玉郎與劉慧娘，裴政與徐雅本是兩對情投意合的戀人，陰差陽錯間，孫玉郎男扮女裝代姊拜堂，劉慧娘則代兄娶妻。他們的婚約誤配，讓成誤會，終鬧上公堂，喬太守將錯就錯，乾脆來了一個亂點，結果正好有情人終成眷屬，皆大歡喜。.

programme.title: 江湖了斷 / Pursuit of a Killer
programme.desc: 故事描述，羅莽、尹相林、強漢、湯鎮宗及左燕翎五人偷渡赴港時，湯不慎誤踏陷阱，羅等欲救不果，看駐軍逼近，只得舍湯而去。四人到港後，三男淪為黑幫打手，一次私下行劫時，失手被捕入獄。尹、強出獄後即被殺害，督察白彪疑是仇家所為，遂提前釋放羅，企圖引出兇手...

programme.title: 鬥氣小神仙 / Puppy Love
programme.desc: 丁安安與雍晴兩個表姐妹自小就讀於同一所女校，因二人的母親一向口和心不和，從小就向自己女兒灌輸好勝思想，因此形成安安與晴從小鬥到大，三日一小吵，五日一大鬥。她們在校中認識了男同學米高及保羅，很快成為情侶，兩對小冤家後來因鬥氣竟然互調了男朋友….

programme.title: 小煞星 / The Singing Killer
programme.desc: 強宜本是夜總會歌星，後來為尋初戀女友水仙的下落，被人帶到匪幫的木屋。原來，強宜少年時誤入歧途，有打劫殺人的犯罪紀錄，綽號「小煞星」。一哥要脅他共同打劫珠寶行，否則公開他的秘密。強宜假意應承，從長計議。想不到當日行動踏入珠寶行，發現售貨員竟然是初戀女友水仙！.

programme.title: 弟子也瘋狂 / Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: 方世玉、洪熙官及胡惠乾三大少林俗家弟子初抵寺，即與悟清等出家弟子互爭高下，使到少林無日安寧，連方丈亦啼笑皆非。.

programme.title: 風流斷劍小小刀 / The Deadly Breaking Sword
programme.desc: 大俠段長青在一小鎮得遇名妓柳銀絮，柳懇求段殺死現以「神醫」為名的黑道高手郭天勝，為其未婚夫報仇。段聯同鎮內賭坊護衛高門殺入郭家，正邪兩派惡鬥連場。.

programme.title: 女巡按 / The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: 影后李菁的代表作，蕭湘反串文必正，傾慕官府小姐霍定金，賣身混入霍家，二人私定終身，必正被陷害入獄，定金設法營救...

programme.title: 御貓三戲錦毛鼠 / Cat VS Rat
programme.desc: 展昭、白玉堂武功不相上下。白一次無意中救了皇帝獲嘉封，卻不相信其身份，揚長而去。後皇帝再遇險，被展所救，展即獲御封。白不忿設計盜去玉璽，欲戲弄展，幸展武功高強，終不辱皇命而回。.

programme.title: 香江花月夜 / Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: 本歌舞片由聲色藝各有千秋的何莉莉、鄭佩佩及秦萍合演三姊妹，再配以三大小生淩雲、陳厚及嶽華大鬥演技。由日本名演導井上梅次執導.

programme.title: 五大漢 / Five Tough Guys
programme.desc: 一班不打不相識之眾，聚集在一起以保護愛國將軍免被加害。他們充當將軍的護送人員，前往危險的遠方英國領事館，途中遭到敵人和日軍的陰險干擾。.

programme.title: 五大漢 / Five Tough Guys
programme.desc: 一班不打不相識之眾，聚集在一起以保護愛國將軍免被加害。他們充當將軍的護送人員，前往危險的遠方英國領事館，途中遭到敵人和日軍的陰險干擾。.

programme.title: 邪完再邪 / Hex after Hex
programme.desc: 女鬼劉阿翠鍾情以前鄰居馬素，欲與其結合，央求父親攜同金銀珠寶向馬提親，撮合一段人鬼姻緣，馬素年青憨直，不願與鬼為伍，堅決拒絕，實則彼暗戀已有男友之鄰居紅卜卜，阿翠洞悉其情，決定伺機行動。.

programme.title: 萬人斬 / Killer Constable
programme.desc: 清朝光緒年間，守衛森嚴的大內金庫，竟遭悍匪劫去黃金二萬兩，慈禧太后大為震怒。外號「萬人斬」的京都捕房總捕頭冷天鷹受命於三個月內，緝捕匪首方逢甲歸案。方逢甲佈署大批匪徒喬裝村民，向冷天鷹施以突擊，冷在猝不及防下終告受傷。失明少女方蘭姑讓冷在屋內養傷，未幾，方逢甲突然出現，原來蘭姑乃其獨女...

programme.title: 兒女是我們的 / The Younger Generation
programme.desc: 富家小姐梅淑卿與窮教師江少文，為了自由戀愛，脫離父母，從城市遷往小鎮結婚生活。他們生育五個兒女，但生存的擔子日重，二人長期辛勞，終相繼亡故。小兒女頓失庇蔭，直接面對複雜的社會，幾乎各散東西…….

programme.title: 陰陽刀 / Twin Blades Of Doom
programme.desc: 大俠張七郎退隱江湖多年，他的妻兒及朋友卻被鬼頭黨所殺。悲憤的七郎打算獨力與鬼王決一生死，為他們報仇雪恨！惡名昭彰的鬼頭黨最終會被他打敗嗎？.

programme.title: 吉祥賭坊 / The Casino
programme.desc: 一對青梅竹馬的情侶相隔多年後在神秘的吉祥賭坊相遇，二人決意要一起剷除貪污的將軍、罪犯和勒索者！.

programme.title: 相思河畔 / River of Tears
programme.desc: 富商之子馮琪偉戀上歌女方碧玉，碧玉身世凄涼，常受流氓頭子林老二及李老三壓榨勒索，幸得琪偉相助並娶之為妻。婚後二人育一子，惜李老三再度敲詐，最終琪偉為愛妻討回公道而與李老三同歸於盡...

programme.title: 蕭十一郎 / Swordsman at Large
programme.desc: 蕭十一郎被人冒名作惡，送"割鹿刀"托連城璧殺蕭。寶刀途中被軒轅無敵奪去。軒欲強搶美女沈璧君，蕭英雄救美。蕭行蹤敗露，被連伏擊重傷，幸為沈所救。蕭決意將寶刀取回...

programme.title: 夕陽戀人 / Sunset
programme.desc: 這是日本導演上梅次文藝片的經典。故事描述井莉飾的車衣女工與秦沛飾的修車工，在夕陽萌生感情，後女因識破男的太子爺身份，深感受騙...

programme.title: 大決鬥 / The Duel
programme.desc: 得知弟弟殺死黑社會頭目後，唐人杰毅然承擔罪責，成為殺手追殺的目標。在江南浪子的協助下，他終於成功復仇，卻驚覺江南浪子正是殺害父親的真兇。.

programme.title: 乾隆下江南 / The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: 乾隆為體察民情，撇下侍衛假扮商人微服出訪江南，期間得知衙門有貪官欺壓百姓，導致民不聊生。這時乾隆遇上一名清廉的賣菜青年，二人合力教訓貪官一頓。最後，青年更被獲封為皇帝的近身侍衛。.

programme.title: 痳瘋怪拳 / The Tigress Of Shaolin
programme.desc: 鐵橋三發覺林縣官與鎮南醫局主持孟平勾結販毒，被追殺，幸得漁家女採嬌所救。採嬌乾爹醉公公介紹鐵到歐陽洪的雜貨店送貨，因而認識酒樓夥計老鼠仔。林與孟查知鐵下落，欲加害鐵，反而使歐陽洪無辜被害。鐵逃入海幢寺，得玄光大師傳授五郎八卦棍，遂與老鼠仔往找孟平報仇….

programme.title: 釣金龜 / The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: 三個歌舞女郎張萍、葉鳳、林芝蘭，隨歌舞團去台北表演，歌舞團經紀陳彼德原與葉拍拖，但陳移情於胡聞鶯。張萍出發前被男友拋棄，葉鳳要從鶯手上追回陳彼德的愛，林芝蘭為卻一心不嫁富豪誓不回。引出烏龍百出的愛情喜劇…….

programme.title: 雙喜臨門 / Double Bliss
programme.desc: 朱國棟和李明珠本打算結婚，無奈雙方父母為多年死對頭，所以堅決反對婚事。於是二人不惜假裝自殺。有見及此雙方家長最終冰釋前嫌，答應二人成婚。此時，唱片公司宣佈會為出棟的歌曲版，最終可謂雙喜臨門。.

programme.title: 金石情 / Forever And Ever
programme.desc: 劉貞蓮不幸身患麻瘋，其父劉員外招贅窮書生李孝文為婿，意圖賣瘋傳毒。貞蓮將真相和盤托出，孝文感於貞蓮真情，決意回鄉稟明母親，迎接貞蓮返家。孝文走後，貞蓮萬念俱灰，竟狂飲毒酒，以圖自盡...

programme.title: 金石情 / Forever And Ever
programme.desc: 劉貞蓮不幸身患麻瘋，其父劉員外招贅窮書生李孝文為婿，意圖賣瘋傳毒。貞蓮將真相和盤托出，孝文感於貞蓮真情，決意回鄉稟明母親，迎接貞蓮返家。孝文走後，貞蓮萬念俱灰，竟狂飲毒酒，以圖自盡...

programme.title: 死囚 / The Condemned
programme.desc: 流浪漢馮大剛被誤指為劫匪，遭逮捕後關押於死囚牢。真正的劫匪為了滅口，賄賂獄中扒手楊靈對馮大剛下毒手。楊靈明白馮大剛是冤枉的，於是暗中設法幫助他逃獄。誰料逃獄計劃意外失敗，最終兩人反而成為真正的死囚。.

programme.title: 卒仔抽車 / Rolls, Rolls, I Love You
programme.desc: 阿旦、墨魚、阿喜、荷官等一群窮小子，遇上生活寂寥的富豪崔東成，達成了一個賭局，要於十日內偷得崔的名車。五人與崔鬥智鬥力，終戰勝億萬富豪！.

programme.title: 奪棍 / The Fighting Fool
programme.desc: 一天，絕代棍王紅鷹被惡霸擄走，徒弟阿檬誓要救出師父。途中，阿檬遇上雖貪財，卻武功了得的朱頭炳。在阿檬的利誘下，朱頭炳決定一同出發營救紅鷹。即使二人南轅北轍，但最終仍合力與惡霸終極一戰。.

programme.title: 蛇王子 / The Snake Prince
programme.desc: 廣西蛇山中有三條巨蛇──蛇王子、黑蛇將及黃蛇將；一夜三蛇化成人形與苗寨男女載歌載舞，蛇王子更因此愛上苗寨女子黑琴。後苗寨旱災，蛇王子答應率蛇作法，引水入寨，但條件是要娶黑琴為妻...

programme.title: 毒龍潭 / Dragon Swamp
programme.desc: 樊瑛受歹徒唐大川欺騙，盜去師父的玉龍劍，並生下一子一女；後樊遭師罰禁毒龍潭，唐抱子虞江逃走，女青兒則歸師公門下；二十年後，劍再次被盜，青女扮男裝，私下尋劍，卻遇樊舊友天涯客...

programme.title: 乾隆下揚州 / The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: 乾隆皇繼續微服南巡，這次得大臣和大學士陪行，他們一行三人來到揚州，期間遇上不少趣事。.

programme.title: 七煞 / To Kill a Mastermind
programme.desc: 由七位壇主控制的「七煞會」，在江湖上掀起腥風血雨, 人人聞風喪膽。朝廷特派刑部尚書楊宇統籌剿滅，並派臥底從內瓦解組織，隨著「七煞會」內衝突不斷升溫，幕後壇主可會找出臥底？.

programme.title: 軍閥趣史 / The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: 此片可謂李翰祥導演，經典作《大軍閥》之延續，焦點在幾位當時得令的豔星，餘莎莉、邵音音及楚湘雲。片中「豔趣」特別多….

programme.title: 金臂童 / The Kid with the Golden Arm
programme.desc: 虎威鏢局總鏢頭楊虎雲受官府之託，押运二十萬兩黃金赴黃河流域賬災，武林豪傑「長斧」殷九、「短斧」方十、「冷月劍」冷鳳、「寒星劍」李青冥等紛紛前來助陣。當時「七殺谷」中一批武功高強的劇盜，早就佈署截劫詭計，鏢隊幸得「千面神捕」海濤沿途暗中出手相助，化險為夷...

programme.title: 鬼馬神偷 / The Big Sting
programme.desc: 魯俊谷、張權、於洋三人乃沙煲兄弟，三人合力獲得寶物「雙面神」，不料卻給胡起尾注，將三人毒殺，獨吞「雙面神」。劉永、梁家仁及梁韻蕊是他們的後人，在不打不相識之下重逢，為了完成亡父的遺志，三人齊心向胡偷回寶物。韻蕊早已混入胡家中，色誘胡之子，作為內應查出「雙面神」之收藏地點。永與家仁則扮鬼扮馬，偷天換日，最後偷得雙面神！.

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳 / The Brave Archer
programme.desc: 郭靖回到中原時，遇上黃蓉，二人一見鍾情雙雙墮入愛河。豈料，同時間歐陽克竟又向黃蓉提親。於是黃藥師決定以比武選婿，對決的勝方可娶女兒黃蓉為妻。經過一輪激戰，郭靖最後成功打敗歐陽克，奪得美人歸。.

programme.title: 乾隆皇與三姑娘 / Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: 乾隆皇愛慕蘇州名妓三姑娘，為了朝夕幽會，竟然在青樓挖了一條地下通道直達紫禁城。青樓內外，乾隆神出鬼沒，嚇破臣下的膽子。乾隆在民間行俠仗義，更在賭坊大破賭局。.

programme.title: 萬花迎春 / The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: 歌舞團台柱陳君邁賦閒多時後，應徵當富家女梅倩如的司機，竟被誤傳戀情。倩如為查明流言的來源，假扮記者採訪歌舞團，期間君邁與倩如暗生好感，經過一番試探後，二人終一舞定情。.

programme.title: 多咀街 / Gossip Street
programme.desc: 「多咀街」是一條丁字形的熱鬧街道，住客大多是各行各業的小市民。他們對社會所發生的大小事情喜歡談論，七嘴八舌，招惹是非；三言兩語，道出人情冷暖，有道是：言為心聲。不管是粵劇藝員、暴發戶、黑社會人物或司機，他們說的話是嬉笑怒罵或冷嘲熱諷也好，都足以反映出現實社會人情百態之一斑。.

programme.title: 多咀街 / Gossip Street
programme.desc: 「多咀街」是一條丁字形的熱鬧街道，住客大多是各行各業的小市民。他們對社會所發生的大小事情喜歡談論，七嘴八舌，招惹是非；三言兩語，道出人情冷暖，有道是：言為心聲。不管是粵劇藝員、暴發戶、黑社會人物或司機，他們說的話是嬉笑怒罵或冷嘲熱諷也好，都足以反映出現實社會人情百態之一斑。.

programme.title: 天龍八部 / The Battle Wizard
programme.desc: 大理國王子段譽不懂武功，卻私自離宮闖蕩江湖。途中，段譽先後遇上玩蛇姑娘鍾靈和同父異母的姊姊木婉清。因緣際會下，段譽吸光朱蝮蟒的血和吃下碧血蛤，得到了絕世功力，最終更擊敗父親的多年仇敵黃袍人。.

programme.title: 裸血 / Raw Passions
programme.desc: 淩波的丈夫高遠及其友王俠，均與肚皮舞女郎孟莉有染，孟藉此勒索二人；後孟被殺，高成嫌疑犯，另孟之兄翟諾，亦向高勒索；而淩在家，也接見了穀峰，他聲言有為高洗罪的證據，但要索錢；王妻李香君借貸給淩... 究竟誰是殺孟真凶？.

programme.title: 太陰指 / Finger of Doom
programme.desc: 故事描述，路天保與兩個結拜兄弟，巧遇奉師命清理門戶的躺棺長髮少女與四行屍人...

programme.title: 遊俠情 / Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: 杜孟飛奉命下山闖蕩江湖，途中救出遭黑道中人捉拿的沐婉兒，杜挺身相救，沐萬分感激。未幾，杜又救出被黑道中人圍攻的少女李賽男。及後，杜無意中得知一段二十年前的江湖恩怨，黑道首領是李之殺父仇人，而沐則是黑道首領失散的女兒….

programme.title: 女殺手 / The Lady Professional
programme.desc: 女殺手被組織控制，強逼去殺商界名人石英，險中殺人滅口的陷阱。她不想淪為殺人工具，決心進行報仇大計，故事曲折離奇...

programme.title: 拜倒石榴裙 / Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: 丁芝華綺年玉貌，衣著華麗，將偷回來的珠寶從香港偷運去星加坡。因鑽石不准進口，芝華情急智生，將戒指盒放進陌生男子張志賢衣袋，順利通過，但當出機場時卻不見志賢的蹤跡。芝華找遍星加坡每一角落，都找不到志賢。一日，芝華到泳場，竟巧遇志賢，她便用盡一切方法去接近志賢欲取回戒指….

programme.title: 龍虎會風雲 / Heroes Of Sung
programme.desc: 故事描述，金兵侵入，身負重傷的未國將軍囑其女、羅烈及張佩山飾的的愛徒，保護太上皇玉璽，不斷出計，最終難免決一死戰...

programme.title: 女兒國 / The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: 本片講述唐僧、孫悟空、豬八戒及沙和尚一行四人往西天取經，行至西梁女兒國，國內全是女人，而傳宗接代生兒育女全靠「招胎泉」，飲過這泉水便可成孕，但也只能生女。.

programme.title: 搏盡 / Godfather of Canton
programme.desc: 碼頭工人林四海，一次助中央特派專員鄭志成脫險，因而得以加入警局；後告發要員收規，獲局長賞識，升為副官；繼而林藉局長三姨太欠下巨額賭債，唆使局長允其代受賄替三姨太還債；林辭去職務在黑道大展拳腳，復與碼頭總管事梅寶聯盟…….

programme.title: 六刺客 / Six Assassins
programme.desc: 鎮國公李明恃強作惡，魚肉百姓。他的兄長雖是當今聖上，卻對李明的惡行束手無策。正氣凜然的劍客穆俊傑假扮成李明的護衛密謀刺殺行動。他先捉拿六名欲殺李明的刺客，再與他們結盟，密謀殺死李明以終止其暴行。.

programme.title: 貂蟬 / Diau Charn
programme.desc: 漢朝末年太師董卓霸道專橫，弄權禍國，忠臣王允誓要利用貂蟬的美色設計除掉董卓。王允得知董卓的義子呂布見貂蟬貌若天仙一見鍾情，於是將計就計把貂蟬獻給董卓為妾，終使父子反目。呂布最後殺了父親董卓，自此與貂蟬成為眷屬。.

programme.title: 決殺令 / Judgement of an Assassin
programme.desc: 百毒派銳意製造武林不和，以實現稱霸江湖的野心。他們派出蒙面刺客殺戮另一門派，但其中一名刺客被捕後即被其他門派公審。最後審訊結果是什麼？最終又能否揭開真相？.

programme.title: 魚美人 / The Mermaid
programme.desc: 張珍與金寵之女牡丹早有婚約，金寵卻欲退婚。張珍偶遇化身金牡丹樣子的鯉魚精，兩人漸生情愫。一天，金寵請包公來公斷兩個真假牡丹，包公為成全二人，推辭此案….

programme.title: 花團錦簇 / Love Parade
programme.desc: 時裝設計師史馬哥向葉德梅徵求她對自己作品的意見，梅卻隨意提出批評，這讓馬哥感到非常不滿。一天，梅準備出席一場盛大的宴會，於是找馬哥為她設計禮服，不料他為報復故意設計了一件小丑裝，讓梅顏面盡失。最終，史馬哥卻很內疚並向梅道歉，兩人冰釋前嫌，並墜入愛河。.

programme.title: PL STORIES
programme.desc: Maya Yoshida quietly became one of the Premier League's most dependable defenders during his years at Southampton, but his influence reached far beyond the pitch. In this episode, we look back at Yoshida's journey from Japan to England's top-flight, his role as a leader for club and country, and the cultural bridge he helped build along the way.

programme.title: PL STORIES

programme.desc: Serial Animasi Keluarga yang membahas kehidupan masyarakat sehari-hari melalui tokoh utama, Pak Somat , Bu Inah, Dudung, Ninung dan warga lainnya yang ber-Bhinneka Tunggal Ika.

programme.title: Petok Si Ayam Kampung
programme.desc: Serial Stop Motion tentang seekor ayam jantan ,bernama "Petok" yang beranjak dewasa, dan merasa dirinya tidak se-spesial hewan-hewan piaraan majikannya. Oleh karena itu Ia selalu berusaha menunjukkan kepada majikannya bahawa Ia adalah ayam yang serba bisa.

programme.title: Samufly
programme.desc: Bos Jahat mengotori sungai dan mengirimkan bom sampah untuk menghancurkan kota, para Samufly dan Master Mantis bertarung dengan Bos Jahat untuk melindungi kota dan menghentikannya.

programme.title: Tim Penyelamat Tayo
programme.desc: Pergi tim penyelamat! Lindungi kota! Kendaraan penyelamat baru, mobil polisi, dan truk pemadam kebakaran datang untuk menyelamatkan!

programme.title: Howie, LandauS Adventures In Seabed
programme.desc: Seri ini menyampaikan nilai-nilai persahabatan, keberanian, keyakinan dan pengampunan kepada anak-anak dan menceritakan kisah-kisah yang dialami Howie dan Landau di dasar laut. Howie, seorang penemu cilik dan Landau, seorang ahli pengetahuan kelautan, pergi ke laut dalam secara tidak sengaja. Mereka datang ke Kerajaan Merman dan terlibat dalam krisis besar di dunia laut.

programme.title: Boboiboy
programme.desc: Ikuti petualangan pahlawan super muda BoBoiBoy, teman robotnya Ochobot, dan teman-teman berkekuatan super mereka, Gopal, Ying, dan Yaya, saat mereka bertarung untuk melindungi Bumi dari ancaman alien yang bertekad menaklukkan planet ini demi mendapatkan biji kakao.

programme.title: Bedu Dan Adul
programme.desc: Bedu dan Adul adalah sebuah serial film animasi 3D tentang petualangan anak-anak di kawasan pinggiran Jakarta.

programme.title: Arpo
programme.desc: Arpo dirancang sebagai robot komando, dibangun sebagai mesin tempur yang ganas. Namun, dengan tercapainya perdamaian dunia, Arpo telah diperlengkapi kembali untuk pengasuhan, diberi kode ulang untuk dipeluk, dan secara resmi dipindahkan sebagai robot pengasuh!

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Serial ini menggambarkan bagaimana karakter-karakter ini selamat dari bahaya kehidupan sehari-hari, secara tidak sengaja mengubah situasi biasa menjadi peristiwa yang tidak terduga, luar biasa, dan selalu lucu.

programme.title: Bedu Dan Adul

programme.title: Tayo The Little Bus
programme.desc: Di kota besar di mana berbagai kendaraan hidup bahagia bersama, bus kecil Tayo baru saja mulai mempelajari rutenya di kota. Ada banyak lagi yang harus dipelajari untuk Tayo. programme.title: Pororos Earth Expedition Tales
programme.desc: Ekspedisi Bumi yang Menyenangkan bersama Pororo! Mari berkeliling dunia dengan pesawat Eddy! Berbagai lanskap, hewan, tumbuhan, dan petualangan yang penuh risiko!

programme.title: Pororos Thematic Show
programme.desc: Tema cerita Pororo dan kawan-kawan. Anda akan diajak ke desa Porong Porong, sebuah tempat yang penuh dengan petualangan.

programme.title: Arpo
programme.desc: Arpo dirancang sebagai robot komando, dibangun sebagai mesin tempur yang ganas. Namun, dengan tercapainya perdamaian dunia, Arpo telah diperlengkapi kembali untuk pengasuhan, diberi kode ulang untuk dipeluk, dan secara resmi dipindahkan sebagai robot pengasuh!

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Serial ini menggambarkan bagaimana karakter-karakter ini selamat dari bahaya kehidupan sehari-hari, secara tidak sengaja mengubah situasi biasa menjadi peristiwa yang tidak terduga, luar biasa, dan selalu lucu.

programme.title: Morphle 2D - English

programme.title: Titipo Titipo
programme.desc: Kereta api kecil yang baru lahir dari Train Center TITIPO baru saja lulus ujian mengemudi dan siap untuk bekerja di Desa Kereta. Meskipun TITIPO bercita-cita menjadi kereta terbaik di dunia, kepribadiannya yang penasaran namun acak menangkapnya dalam peristiwa dan masalah yang tidak terguna setiap hari.

Howie, seorang penemu cilik dan Landau, seorang ahli pengetahuan kelautan, pergi ke laut dalam secara tidak sengaja. Mereka datang ke Kerajaan Merman dan terlibat dalam krisis besar di dunia laut.

programme.title: Pokemon
programme.desc: Saatnya Ash dan Pikachu memulai petualangan mereka di wilayah Kalos! Sepanjang jalan, mereka bergabung dengan beberapa teman baru - seorang penemu jenius bernama Clemont, adik perempuannya Bonnie, dan Serena, seorang Pelatih dalam perjalanan pertamanya. Ash segera mencoba menantang Gym di Lumiose City, tetapi tidak terlalu jauh sebelum robot mengusirnya! Di sela-sela pertarungan Gym, Ash dan teman-temannya akan menjelajahi wilayah unik ini, bertemu semua jenis Pokemon baru, dan mencari misteri Pokemon baru yang menarik!

programme.title: Beri Cinta Waktu
programme.desc: Cerita sinetron ini mengangkat pertemanan di dunia game online. Awalnya hanya sekadar main bareng, lama-lama menjadi jatuh cinta beneran. Cinta Sedalam Rindu?menceritakan Aluna (Esta Pramanita) yang menyembunyikan identitasnya di?game online?sebagai Gulagula. Tak disangka, ia dekat dengan Ezra (Farhan Rasyid) yang memakai nama Ezy. Ezra jatuh cinta dan ingin bertemu, tapi Aluna terus menghindar karena malu. Untuk mengetahui keseruan ceritanya saksikan tayangannya setiap hari, hanya di SCTV.

programme.title: Jejak Duka Diandra
programme.desc: Kisah cinta Diandra (Michelle Ziudith) dan Dimitri (Rio Dewanto) yang semula indah, seketika berubah drastis setelah Yunita (Baiti Syaghaf), saudara tiri Diandra mengaku mencintai Dimitri. Dimitri terjebak dalam situasi sulit akibat ulah sang adik, Jupiter (Bizael) yang menuduh Dimitri melecehkan Yunita. Hubungan Dimitri dengan Diandra pun semakin merenggang. Tuduhan lainnya juga harus diterima Dimitri sebagai penyebab insiden kecelakaan seorang wanita. Posisi Dimitri semakin terpojok setelah Diandra yang diminta sebagai saksi justru tidak berpihak kepadanya hingga Dimitri mendapat sanksi mendekam di balik jeruji besi selama lima tahun.Lima tahun berlalu, Dimitri hidup bebas dan melanjutkan usaha sang ayah. Ia pun membuka kisah cinta baru dengan Melissa (Tasya Panggabean). Takdir pun berkata lain, pertemuan Dimitri dan Diandra kembali terjadi...kisah selengkapnya, silakan saksikan hanya di SCTV.

programme.desc: Kisah dua sahabat baik yang berhadapan dengan konflik perhubungan di saat mereka mula panik memikirkan usia mereka yang semakin meningkat tetapi belum bertemu jodoh.

programme.desc: Ketika melarikan diri dari bekas suaminya, Ihyana telah mengalami kemalangan tetapi dia bernasib baik kerana telah diselamatkan oleh satu entiti luar biasa yang telah mengubah kelakuannya.

programme.title: Gengster Leng Chai
programme.desc: Black is a failure of a gangster, being too soft hearted with people. After meeting Mawar, he is determined to change despite the objections of others.

programme.title: Strawberi Karipap Sesat Kat Paris
programme.desc: Nini and Haikal start their big adventure to find their aunty Lisa who gets a job offer as a professional photographer in Paris. Unfortunately, their journey turns upside down when they arrive in Paris and ruin a newly-wed coupleís honeymoon.

programme.title: Nota Silam
programme.desc: Munirah menjumpai sebuah nota cinta di dalam sebuah buku yang diperolehi secara rambang dari 'blind date with a book' dan cuba untuk menemukan pasangan di dalam nota tersebut yang merubah hidup Munirah.

programme.title: Bukan Cerita Cinta Cliche
programme.desc: Seorang penulis skrip kisah-kisah cinta tetapi masih bersendirian mengimpikan cinta dalam kehidupan realitinya, lalu dia menyertai sebuah kumpulan terapi untuk berkongsi masalah peribadinya.

programme.title: Puyah & Putat
programme.desc: Kisah pengembaraan Puyah, seorang gadis kampung becok yang disukai ramai, apabila dia melawat Kuala Lumpur dan termasuk set filem secara tak sengaja, dan tak semena-mena mula mendapat nama sebagai pelakon.

programme.title: Ting Tong, Love
programme.desc: Bored by his mother's insistence on his getting married, Hairi finally agrees on the condition that he could choose his own soul mate. Does the choice of Hairi meet with his mother's approval?

programme.title: Chomel
programme.desc: After her mother's death, Mimi's family fell apart. One day, Mimi finds Chomel, a cat and brings it home, only for it to cause a series of events that brings her broken family back together again.

programme.title: My Future Husband
programme.desc: Emily berharap untuk menemui bakal suami dan pada suatu hari muncul seorang lelaki bernama Atta yang mengaku dia adalah suami Emily dari masa hadapan.

programme.title: Perangkap Perkahwinan
programme.desc: Three best friends promised to get married, at the same time when they turn 26 years old. Their perceptions of marriage life begin to change and conflict ensues.

programme.title: Cik Puan Sinderella
programme.desc: This is a lighthearted family drama about a teenage girl who is closely guarded by her mother.

programme.title: Anak Kerak
programme.desc: Husin telah menggunakan ilmu hitam iaitu dengan ‘Anak Kerak' demi untuk mendapatkan kekebalan, kesenangan dan kemewahan hidup di dunia.

programme.title: Jatuh Cinta Buta
programme.desc: Telefilem komedi romantik tentang perkenalan singkat di antara Zulin, seorang gadis yang tidak pernah bercinta, dengan Izlan, seorang duda dalam satu 'blind date' yang diaturkan oleh Nadya Ramanshah.

programme.title: Matahari
programme.desc: Fauzi seorang guru yang telah dihantar untuk berkhidmat di Sabah. Di sana dia telah berkenalan dengan seorang novelis yang sedang mengalami masalah ‘writer’s block’ iaitu Yazid.

programme.title: Meniti Cinta Di Starimost
programme.desc: Iman dipaksa berkahwin dengan Qaseh, anak kepada orang gajinya untuk mewarisi harta bapanya. Percutian mereka di Bosnia membuahkan bibit-bibit cinta. Lakonan Iqram Dinzly, Zarina Zainoordin dan Yana Shamsudin.

programme.title: We’ll be back at 6.00am
programme.desc: We’ll be back at 6.00am.

programme.title: Jula Juli Bintang Putus Cinta
programme.desc: Telemovie sekuel Jula Juli Bintang Cinta kini kembali! Kali ini, Jula dan Juli mengalami konflik percintaan dengan Dani & Izham sehingga mereka memutuskan untuk berpisah dan melarikan diri ke kampung Juli.

programme.title: Kampung Kuala Lambat
programme.desc: Kampung Kuala Lambat bagai mengalami sumpahan apabila lelaki yang berkahwin muda akan mati di hari pernikahan mereka namun kejadian ganjil ini tidak berlaku kepada lelaki yang berusia 60 tahun ke atas.

programme.title: Musnahkan Pelamin Anganku
programme.desc: Mikael yang merupakan seorang wedding planner menerima tawaran besar untuk menjayakan sebuah majlis perkahwinan pelanggannya. Namun majlis perkahwinan tersebut merupakan majlis bekas isterinya.

programme.title: Dua
programme.desc: Kisah Farhan yang kehilangan kembarnya Fahrin dalam satu kemalangan tragis. Dia kemudiannya mengambil-alih kehidupan Fahrin namun terperangkap dalam sebuah cinta tiga segi pula. Lakonan Eusoff Hashim dan Sharifah Sakinah.

programme.title: Racun Menantu
programme.desc: After marrying Zain, Sara lived in the same house with Pak Dolah, her father-in-law. Because of the family's grudge, Sara started making trouble by seducing her own father-in-law.

programme.title: Cupid
programme.desc: Kisah mengenai seorang ejen yang bekerja di sebuah syarikat penghancur jodoh yang ditugaskan untuk memikat seorang wanita supaya dapat melupakan suaminya yang telah diisytiharkan meninggal dunia. Namun dia jatuh cinta pada wanita tersebut.

programme.title: Cerai
programme.desc: Pengalaman berkurung dengan pasangan selama musim PKP memaksa dua pasangan suami isteri menilai semula perkahwinan mereka yang telah disalah ertikan selama ini.

programme.title: Hingga Jumpa Lagi
programme.desc: Eva is diagnosed with cancer and prays that she could travel back to the past in order to prevent the love between her and her husband so that her husband can lead a happy life. Her prayer is granted….

programme.title: I Heart You Cik Yah
programme.desc: Zulkefli and Badariah are always arguing, but in order to prevent the factory where they work from being closed by Qarina, they must work together. Out of hatred, they start feeling for each other.

programme.title: Jihan Nak Displin Anak
programme.desc: Jihan dan suami kalut apabila anak mereka tidak mahu pulang beraya di kampung. Mereka cuba untuk mendisiplinkan anak mereka sebelum hari raya.

programme.title: Satu Kampung Dua Orang
programme.desc: Selepas banjir besar melanda, semua penduduk kampung berpindah kerana kampung mereka tidak lagi selamat. Hanya dua beradik yang enggan berpindah atas sebab dan alasan mereka tersendiri.

programme.desc: Emily berharap untuk menemui bakal suami dan pada suatu hari muncul seorang lelaki bernama Atta yang mengaku dia adalah suami Emily dari masa hadapan.

programme.title: Perangkap Perkahwinan

programme.title: Cik Puan Sinderella
programme.desc: This is a lighthearted family drama about a teenage girl who is closely guarded by her mother.

programme.title: Anak Kerak

programme.title: Jatuh Cinta Buta

programme.title: Matahari

programme.title: Meniti Cinta Di Starimost

programme.title: Moonstruck
programme.desc: An Italian-American widow (Cher), engaged to a reticent suitor, falls in love with his brother (Nicolas Cage). Starring Cher, Nicolas Cage, Vincent Gardenia.

programme.title: Mob Cops
programme.desc: When a retired NYPD detective writes a book about his familys ties to the mob, it ignites a firestorm between dirty cops working for a brutal crime boss and the officers trying to bring them to justice. Starring David Arquette, Jeremy Luke, Danny A. Abeckaser.

programme.title: Sicario
programme.desc: Recruited by Matt Graver, FBI agent Kate Macer joins a task force for the escalating war against drugs. Led by the intense Alejandro, the team travels back-and-forth across the U.S.-Mexican border, using one cartel boss to flush out a bigger one. Starring Emily Blunt, Benicio del Toro, Josh Brolin.

programme.title: Run This Town
programme.desc: A journalist and a political aide become entangled in a larger-than-life scandal. Starring Ben Platt, Mena Massoud, Nina Dobrev.

programme.title: Spider
programme.desc: Haunted by his childhood, a psychotic loner (Ralph Fiennes) has difficulty after his release from a mental institution. Starring Ralph Fiennes, Miranda Richardson, Gabriel Byrne.

programme.title: Hector and the Search for Happiness
programme.desc: A search by a disillusioned psychiatrist for the key to his happiness takes him around the world on a journey. Starring Simon Pegg, Toni Collette, Rosamund Pike.

programme.title: Whale
programme.desc: A young boy is sent to live with his grandparents in a remote indigenous community. Starring Timmy Masso, Grace George, Joe Martin.

programme.title: Ozzy
programme.desc: A lovable dog must rely on some new friends to help it break out of canine prison and get back home to his owners. Starring Jeff Foxworthy, Rob Schneider, Frankie Quiñones.

programme.title: Finding Neverland
programme.desc: Writer J.M. Barrie (Johnny Depp) befriends a widow (Kate Winslet) and her four sons who inspire him to create the character Peter Pan. Starring Johnny Depp, Kate Winslet, Julie Christie.

programme.title: Steel Magnolias
programme.desc: Based on the play about six Southern women who become close friends despite their eccentricities and complicated lives. Starring Sally Field, Dolly Parton, Shirley MacLaine.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Born with facial differences that, up until now, have prevented him from going to a mainstream school, Auggie Pullman becomes the most unlikely of heroes when he enters the local fifth grade. Starring Julia Roberts, Owen Wilson, Jacob Tremblay.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Accidentally separated from his family as a child, Saroo Brierley returns to India 25 years later to find them. Starring Dev Patel, Rooney Mara, David Wenham.

programme.title: The Unbreakable Boy
programme.desc: When Scott and Teresa learn their son, Austin, is autistic and has brittle bone disease, they worry about his future. However, with Scotts growing faith and Austins incredible spirit, they find joy, gratitude and courage in the most trying times. Starring Zachary Levi, Meghann Fahy, Patricia Heaton.

programme.title: Daddy Day Camp
programme.desc: Chaos reigns when two clueless fathers (Cuba Gooding Jr., Paul Rae) take charge of a dilapidated summer camp and its ill-behaved attendees. Starring Cuba Gooding, Lochlyn Munro, Paul Rae.

programme.title: The War With Grandpa
programme.desc: Forced to give up his room to his grandfather, a scheming boy devises a series of outrageous pranks in an attempt to make him move out. Starring Robert De Niro, Uma Thurman, Rob Riggle.

programme.title: The BMF Documentary: Blowing Money Fast
programme.desc: As law enforcement tightens their grip, a wiretap on Terry Flenorys phone provides a critical breakthrough; the divide between the brothers grows, eventually splitting BMF into two separate divisions.

programme.title: New Jack City
programme.desc: Two ex-policemen attempt to bring down a powerful drug lords ghetto empire in a drug-ravaged metropolis. Starring Wesley Snipes, Ice-T, Judd Nelson.

programme.title: Sicario: Day of the Soldado
programme.desc: FBI agent Matt Graver calls on operative Alejandro Gillick when Mexican drug cartels start to smuggle terrorists across the U.S. border. The war escalates even further when Alejandro kidnaps a kingpins daughter to deliberately increase the tensions. Starring Benicio del Toro, Josh Brolin, Isabela Merced.

programme.title: Adventures in Public School
programme.desc: Socially awkward Liam has been home-schooled his whole life. When he falls in love with a popular one-legged girl, he abandons his mothers suffocating love and enrolls in a public school, entering a world of sex, drugs and social studies. Starring Judy Greer, Daniel Doheny, Siobhan Williams.

programme.title: Before Sunrise
programme.desc: An American (Ethan Hawke) and a Frenchwoman (Julie Delpy) meet on a train and spend a romantic day and night in Vienna. Starring Ethan Hawke, Julie Delpy, Erni Mangold.

programme.title: Before Sunset
programme.desc: A novelist (Ethan Hawke) and an environmentalist (Julie Delpy) who met on a train nine years earlier reunite in Paris. Starring Ethan Hawke, Julie Delpy, Vernon Dobtcheff.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: While transporting a usually docile Abnormal, Magnuss helicopter crashes, leaving her and Will stranded in the shaft of an abandoned oil rig; they soon find they are not alone in the water.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: While an old friend of Magnus, a pouched abnormal named Jimmy, is handing over a fire elemental to the Sanctuary team, they are attacked by a gang of criminal abnormals from Chicago; the situation presents a lot of mysteries to be solved quickly.

programme.title: Blizzard
programme.desc: A youngster learns about true friendship with the help of a magically gifted reindeer from the North Pole. Starring Brenda Blethyn, Christopher Plummer, Kevin Pollak.

programme.title: Perfect High
programme.desc: A teens (Bella Thorne) life spirals out of control when she starts abusing painkillers and heroin with her new friends (Israel Broussard, Daniela Bobadilla) from school. Starring Bella Thorne, Israel Broussard, Daniela Bobadilla.

programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: A New Jersey teen (Ralph Macchio) moves to California, meets bullies and learns karate from a handyman, Mr. Miyagi (Noriyuki "Pat" Morita). Starring Ralph Macchio, Pat Morita, Elisabeth Shue.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part II
programme.desc: Mr. Miyagi returns to Okinawa with his karate student and meets an old foes challenge to a duel. Starring Ralph Macchio, Pat Morita, Martin Kove.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part III
programme.desc: Mr. Miyagi (Noriyuki "Pat" Morita) and his student (Ralph Macchio) open a bonsai-tree shop, then fight thugs sent by a millionaire toxic-waste dumper. Starring Ralph Macchio, Pat Morita, Robyn Lively.

programme.title: The Next Karate Kid
programme.desc: Mr. Miyagi teaches karate to an angry orphan being bullied at her high school. Starring Hilary Swank, Pat Morita, Michael Ironside.

programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: American boy Dre Parkers fighting skills are no match for Cheng, the school bully. He finds a friend in Mr. Han, a maintenance man who is also a martial-arts master. Mr. Han teaches Dre kung fu in the hope that Dre will be able to face down Cheng. Starring Jaden Smith, Jackie Chan, Taraji P. Henson.

programme.title: Higher Learning
programme.desc: The harsh realities of identity, sex, politics and racism greet the incoming freshmen of Columbus University. Starring Omar Epps, Kristy Swanson, Michael Rapaport.

programme.title: The Girlfriend Experience
programme.desc: Christine assumes total control.

programme.title: The Girlfriend Experience
programme.desc: Erica Myles, a finance director at a super PAC, enlists the services of escort Anna in an attempt to gain a secret.
